coral.title: Zero-login code execution with instant live preview.
coral.description: Stop wasting time registering accounts or hitting paywalls just to test an HTML snippet or experiment with a CSS trick. LadeCompile compiles your three files in a debounced, isolated worker bridge right in your client.

pipeline.footer: High reliability · Zero tracking · Unblocked performance

features.heading: Every feature you need — none of the paywalls.
features.subheading: A focused developer workbench that eliminates the friction of traditional web playgrounds.

cards.sharingBody: Your code is compressed straight into the browser URL hash using LZ-String. Share snippets with colleagues without creating an account or sending data to a database.
cards.exportBody: Download your HTML, CSS, and JS bundle as a ready-to-deploy ZIP, copy standalone single-file HTML, or snap a crisp high-res screenshot of your rendered UI.
cards.monacoTitle: VS Code Precision in Your Browser
cards.monacoBody: Built on Monaco Editor, LadeCompile provides native syntax highlighting, intelligent indentation, code formatting, find-and-replace, and native keyboard shortcuts.
cards.startersBody: Start from a blank canvas or choose from verified templates: modern CSS Grid dashboards, responsive landing pages, interactive forms with client validation, dark mode cards, HTML5 canvas animations, and weather API widgets.

tabbed.heading: Engineered for uncluttered focus.
tabbed.subheading: Explore how each part of LadeCompile fits together to give you a clean, reliable coding workflow.

tabs.tab1Desc: Independent HTML, CSS, and JS tabs with automatic syntax formatting.
tabs.tab2Desc: Live postMessage error and log forwarding with unread count badges.
tabs.tab3Desc: Changes persist automatically in localStorage; work survives reloads.
tabs.tab4Desc: Confirmation guards prevent accidental loss when loading starters or resetting.

tabbed.defaultDesc: Switch smoothly between index.html, styles.css, and script.js without clutter. Each tab runs full Monaco IntelliSense and error markers with independent undo history.

cards.gridDesc: Responsive multi-column metric cards with modern CSS grid gap and media queries.
cards.flexboxDesc: Clean hero band, navigation bar, responsive pricing grid, and accessible form.
cards.formDesc: Real-time email and password regex validation with clear visual feedback states.
cards.particleDesc: Interactive 60fps HTML5 canvas particles reacting smoothly to cursor movement.
cards.weatherDesc: Asynchronous Fetch API implementation with loading states and error handling.
cards.todoDesc: Complete CRUD list with filter tabs and client-side persistence.

cream.title: The path to 10× faster prototyping for developers, educators, and students.
cream.body: Whether teaching a frontend bootcamp or quickly demonstrating a bug fix on a call, requiring users to log in before they can see or edit code creates avoidable friction. LadeCompile keeps the entire loop zero-login: open the link, edit immediately, share the new URL.

comparison.heading: A free OneCompiler alternative — without the asterisks.
comparison.subheading: OneCompiler and CodePen are great tools. The difference is the business model: LadeCompile provides the core editing experience without accounts, paywalls, or gated actions.
comparison.footnote: *Comparison based on publicly available web editor features as of 2026. LadeCompile is built to provide an unencumbered free alternative for modern web developers.

cta.title: Start building with LadeCompile right now.
cta.body: No signup forms, no verification emails, and no credit card. Jump straight into the Monaco editor and begin writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
